- Sumatran Orangutan Conservation Program: PASS (1.0, 1.0) — Dedicated long-term rehabilitation and safe habitat placement successfully restored wild breeding.

Conservationists have spent 15 years releasing rehabilitated, orphaned, or rescued orangutans into Sumatra's Jantho Pine Forest. With at least 10 babies born wild, the reserve has successfully sparked a brand new, self-sustaining population of critically endangered Sumatran great apes.
